articles.summary: WESTFIELD, Mass., July 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Western New England Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company” or “WNEB”) (NasdaqGS: WNEB), the holding company for Westfield Bank (the “Bank”), announced today the unaudited results of operations for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026.
